operations.name: message.post

transport.authentication: transport-derived principal; body actor field rejected

response.receipt: commandId/requestHash/observedRevision/verifiedAt; provider result remains queued/unknown until reconciled
response.queryData: authorized typed domain DTO; no hidden total/title

operations.expectedRevisionPolicy: required for mutable existing aggregate; create idempotency required; CRDT update uses document causal frontier + policy fence instead of scalar content CAS

data.description: Domain result DTO definitions: domainApiContracts for provider/CRM/media; reject unauthorized fields before serialization

migrations.status: proposed migration identifier; actual filename generated by selected migrator, no fabricated timestamp

commonColumns.workspace_id: uuid NOT NULL except globally auth principals
commonColumns.entity_id: text canonical kind:id for entity-owned tables

constraints.name: entity_identity
constraints.definition: Entity-owned row composite FK (workspace_id,entity_id) -> entity; principal/receipt/job tables own typed key

constraints.name: idempotency
constraints.definition: UNIQUE(workspace_id, actor_principal_id, idempotency_key) for command_receipt; request_hash checked on conflict

constraints.name: event_delivery
constraints.definition: UNIQUE(consumer_id,event_id); claimed lease separate processed; aggregate_revision+policy/tombstone fence enforced

migrations.domainConstraints: channel/member, discussion parent ref, message revisions, thread parent validation
indexes: backlink target/type indexes when links introduced

migrations.rollback: before cutover restore writer route and snapshot; after accepted shared writes forward repair or verified reverse replay; never delete recent writes

scenario + meaningful seeded failure control + recovery

uiSlice.goal: Project Channels directory, Channel/DM/group composer, replies/threads/reactions/read/typing; entity Discussion shared Message parent. Live call button capability-disabled untilWP31.
uiSlice.boundary: ScreenRefs are the final shared behavior reference. Each WP implements only its assigned slice below; dependency mechanisms are consumed, not rewritten. Full surface DoD closes after every owner slice and required lane succeeds.
uiSlice.screenFinalDoD: Referenced full-screen contracts are shared final behavior; this WP owns only uiSlice goal. Reuse prerequisite code. Do not mark full screen done before other feature owners finish.

contractSupplement.precedence: Revision3 supplement + leaf contracts refine original primary schemas; extend/test typed schemas before new control dispatch; alias means one authority

targetOperationContracts.precedence: Effective canonical payload + action-specific payload variant and mapping override historical primary only for these forms. Original104 schemas remain historical, not silently cast. Server semantic ACL/CAS/time/provider validation remains required.
